messages:
maria-sales: Heads-up — Orion Health just uploaded a SIG/CAIQ and a custom security questionnaire into the thread. Sales needs intake + assignment. They want answers before the onboarding call next Wed. Can someone pick this up? cc @alex-security @devon-se

devon-se: Scope check — POC will process de‑identified PHI and store audit logs. We should confirm data flow and retention requirements.

alex-security: I can take this. Quick Qs for the intake: 1) Do they require customer‑managed keys (KMS/HSM)? 2) Any on‑prem or air‑gapped requirements? 3) Do they expect SOC2 / pen test artifacts?

maria-sales: They explicitly asked about KMS/HSM and SOC2 + a completed SIG baseline. No on‑prem.

security-bot: New intake created: RISK-ORION-2026-03-1812349999. Attachments: sig_orion_03-18.pdf, orion_custom_qs.xlsx. Queue: security-intake.

alex-security: Assigned to @alex-security. Initial ETA ~72h if straightforward — will triage and map SIG -> answers.

nora-legal: I'll prepare NDA/DPA templates in case they request artifact exchange. Flag any non-standard clauses here and I'll review.

sam-se: For the POC: they'll want an IP allowlist and webhook ports. Can we confirm allowed ports (443 + 8443) and whether we need a staging org on dedicated infra?

alex-security: Notes for answers: we support customer KMS via AWS KMS and GCP KMS. HSM is on the roadmap but not generally available today. SOC2 Type II report and penetration test summary available under NDA. For SIG responses we'll supply yes/no plus control refs.

alex-security: ```
Checklist:
[ ] Triage complete
[ ] Attach SOC2 + pen test under NDA
[ ] Provide KMS answer + example config steps
[ ] Complete SIG/CAIQ mapping (control refs)
[ ] Final review by Legal
ETA: 4 business days (updated)
```

maria-sales: :thumbsup: thanks — please flag any deal‑blocking items ASAP so I can notify the customer success / revenue teams.

alex-security: If they insist on HSM or on‑prem deployment that becomes an enterprise gating item (>QBR feature). Will call out as blocker if present.

devon-se: Also: customer asked about L4 allowlist for streaming TCP and retention controls for logs. We'll need exact CIDRs and retention policy requirements.

alex-security: Retention summary we'll include in answers. Quick snippet I'll paste into the response: ```
Retention window:
- default: 30d
- enterprise: up to 365d (contract)
KMS options:
- AWS KMS: customer-managed key supported (ARN required)
- GCP KMS: supported (key resource path required)
HSM: roadmap, contact support for timeline
```

nora-legal: I'll review the final draft before sending. If SOC2 artifacts are requested, I'll handle the exchange under NDA and request compliance to pull artifacts.

alex-security: Working doc (private): https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-ORION-1 — updating SIG mapping as I go.

maria-sales: Great. Keep me posted on any changers to ETA or blockers.

alex-security: Status update: Assigned -> In progress. Will post completed SIG mapping + attachments back here when ready.

maria-sales: Thanks team, closing the loop for now.
